name: Fungal Whispers
body:
School: divination; Level fungomancer 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a piece of mushroom)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one plant or fungus touched
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You can ask questions of and receive answers from plants and fungi, gaining information about the surrounding area. The spell doesn’t make plant creatures any more friendly or cooperative than normal.

Furthermore, wary and cunning plant creatures are likely to be terse and evasive, while the more stupid ones make inane comments. If a plant creature is friendly toward you, it may do some favor or service for you.
